title: Criterion enrichment sidecar
description: criteria/<code>.sidecar.json. Joins stable semantic IDs and instance-data bindings to the structural nodes of one criterion in espd-edm.json, keyed by the node's requestpath. A criterion is 'modeled' when it has a sidecar. Keys starting with '$' are annotations.

code.description: Criterion code as in espd-edm.json (e.g. slc-stand-to-gen). Must equal the file name stem.

id.description: Stable semantic id of the criterion.

tag.description: EA tag of the criterion root (e.g. C29), where it cannot be derived.

containerPath.description: Path of the container object in the instance document that holds this criterion (first segment names the part, e.g. partIV).

source.description: Which criterion field names the criterion's key inside the container.

components.description: Keyed by the structural node's requestpath.

branchSelectors.description: Optional: selectors for criteria whose response shape depends on a chosen branch.

id.description: Stable semantic id of the node; unique across all sidecars.

side.description: Whether the node is authored by the buyer (request) or answered by the economic operator (response).

path.description: Path of the value inside the criterion's instance object.

repeatable.description: On a group binding: the group is a 0..n array container.

codelist.description: Per-leaf codelist name for generic CODE value types.

requestValue.description: Override of how the buyer-side value is serialised in the Request XML.
